verdict.rationale: Render clearly supports deploying full-stack apps with managed infrastructure, autoscaling, and no server management (render-docs-1, render-docs-11, render-docs-9), but the evidence pack lacks any explicit mention of a serverless 'functions' offering (e.g., FaaS) — Render's model is service/container-based rather than function-based. missing for 10: explicit serverless/functions product, evidence of function-level auto-scaling to zero, first-party FaaS documentation.
